_readme: One entry per public register. Download each list to registries/raw/ (git-ignored), fill 'file' and 'as_of' with the date printed on the list, then run: python -m lender_engine sources --inspect (to see what the parser reads) and python -m lender_engine sources (to build the pool). 'include': true puts the register's rows in the enrichment pool; false keeps them in registry_pool_full.csv only. Formats: pdf, xlsx, csv, or extract (a hand-made CSV with columns name,registry_id,hq,extra). URLs and dates below were last checked on 2026-09-17 and must be re-checked on the day the pool is built.

registers.source: Starter extract: the six BSP-licensed digital banks as reported by the Philippine News Agency (24 August 2022). Placeholder until the BSP directory row is used.
registers.notes: Press source, not the register. The BSP has since lifted its moratorium on digital bank licences, so this list is incomplete. Replace with the BSP directory (digital banks) and delete this entry.

registers.source: BSP directory of banks: digital banks
registers.notes: TO VERIFY: locate the current 'Directory of Banks and Non-Bank Financial Institutions' on bsp.gov.ph (the old path was /banking/directory.asp), download the digital banks sheet, record the as-of date printed on it. Map 'columns' to the actual headers after running --inspect.

registers.source: BSP directory of banks: thrift banks
registers.notes: Same directory as above, thrift banks sheet. Around 40 entities: all in the enrichment pool.

registers.source: BSP directory of banks: rural and cooperative banks
registers.notes: Several hundred entities. Kept in the full pool, not enriched by default; to enrich a subset (for example the largest by assets, from BSP published statistics), build a hand-made extract of that subset and add it as a separate register with include=true.

registers.source: SEC list of recorded online lending platforms
registers.notes: The list names the operating company and its platform(s). Record the as-of date printed on the PDF. These lenders already take applications online, so the document-based underwriting pain is the most visible here.

registers.source: SEC list of financing companies with certificate of authority (RA 8556)
registers.notes: Around 700 entities. Full pool only by default. The public versions of this list have carried different as-of dates; use the most recent one on sec.gov.ph and record its date. Kita's team is the right judge of which financing companies are worth enriching.

registers.source: SEC list of lending companies with certificate of authority (RA 9474)
registers.notes: Full pool only by default (thousands of small entities). The OLP list above is the enriched subset.

registers.source: SEC list of revoked and suspended lending and financing companies
registers.notes: Not a prospect list: a gate. Any name in the enrichment pool that also appears here should get closeability near 0.1 (see the closeability rubric). Cross-checking is done by the enrichment prompt from public data today; a hard join on this extract is a small next step.
